title: Defenestrator: Codex
description: OpenAI Codex usage as sampled by the defenestrator: its weekly window (and, on plans that have one, a 5-hour window), what the defenestrator did, and when it ran. Data: defenestrator_usage and defenestrator_event with provider=codex.

list.name: Defenestrator pings
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_event" and r._field == "reason" and r.provider == "codex" and r.kind == "ping")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: "Defenestrator started a window: " + r._value}))

panels.title: Weekly: projected at reset
panels.description: Where this week ends up at the rate of the last 72 hours of it. 100 or more: you are on course to hit the weekly cap.

targets.query:
import "array"

now_s = float(v: int(v: now())) / 1000000000.0

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -72h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "codex" and (r._field == "u7" or r._field == "reset7"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u7 and exists r.reset7 and r.reset7 > now_s)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(identity: {n: 0, u0: 0.0, t0: 0.0, u1: 0.0, t1: 0.0, reset: 0.0},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({n: accumulator.n + 1,
                                      u0: if accumulator.n == 0 then r.u7 else accumulator.u0,
                                      t0: if accumulator.n == 0 then float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0 else accumulator.t0,
                                      u1: r.u7, t1: float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, reset: r.reset7}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      slope = if r.t1 > r.t0 and r.u1 > r.u0 then (r.u1 - r.u0) / (r.t1 - r.t0) else 0.0
      return {_time: now(), _value: r.u1 + slope * (r.reset - now_s)}
    })

panels.title: Last sample age
panels.description: Age of the newest Codex sample. Yellow after 25 minutes, red after an hour: the sampler is failing (see docs/operations.md).

panels.title: Weekly utilization vs even pace
panels.description: Weekly Codex usage against a straight line from 0% at the start of the window to 100% at its reset; red where usage is above the line. Orange markers are weekly windows the defenestrator started.

panels.title: Weekly fill rate vs safe rate
panels.description: How fast the weekly window fills, in percentage points per day (resets excluded). The dashed safe rate is (100 - used) / days left: the steady rate that lands on exactly 100% at the reset. Above it you will hit the cap early.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "codex" and r._field == "u7")
  |> derivative(unit: 1d, nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "points per day"})

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "codex" and (r._field == "u7" or r._field == "reset7"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u7 and exists r.reset7)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: (100.0 - r.u7) / ((r.reset7 - float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0) / 86400.0), left: (r.reset7 - float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0) / 86400.0}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.left > 0.5)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "safe rate"})

panels.title: Usage per day
panels.description: Percentage points of the weekly window used each day (the daily rise in weekly utilization; a reset day shows only its part after the reset).

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"

option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Denver")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "codex" and r._field == "u7")
  |> group()
  |> difference()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if exists r._value then r._value else 0.0}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      day = date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d)
      names = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]
      return {r with day: names[date.weekDay(t: day)] + " " + string(v: date.month(t: day)) + "/" + string(v: date.monthDay(t: day))}
    })
  |> keep(columns: ["day", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "points used"})

    })

  |> rename(columns: {_value: "hours capped"})

panels.title: Decision log
panels.description: Every Codex decision, newest first: weekly windows started, windows running, skips (not logged in) and errors. Sampler errors are shared with the Claude board.

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

panels.title: 5-hour window (only for plans that have one)
5-hour utilization (last 2 days)
panels.description: Account-wide 5-hour usage. The dashed line is an even pace from 0% at the window start to 100% at its reset; the red band is where usage is above it, i.e. you are burning faster than the window allows.

panels.title: 5-hour windows started per day
panels.description: A new 5-hour window shows as a jump of about 5 hours in the reset time between samples. Counts windows however they started (a ping or your own use), so more windows a day is the point of the defenestrator.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"

option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Denver")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "codex" and r._field == "reset5")
  |> difference(nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 600.0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if exists r._value then r._value else 0}))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "windows started"})
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      day = date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d)
      names = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]
      return {r with day: names[date.weekDay(t: day)] + " " + string(v: date.month(t: day)) + "/" + string(v: date.monthDay(t: day))}
    })
  |> keep(columns: ["day", "windows started"])
